root_cause: Torch acos is a VML kernel. AT_MKL_ENABLED && !__APPLE__ specializes vml::vacos<float> to vmsAcos; sqrt specializes to vmsSqrt. AVX512 capability does not identify the elementary-math provider.

implementation_proposal: One explicitly selected/versioned elementary-math profile at asvf preparation; store profile+library version/digest+mode in provenance and relevant cache/checkpoint identities.
M1 uses source-provenanced SLEEF FMA helper; Cura uses standalone pinned oneMKL CPU runtime vmsSqrt followed by vmsAcos in bounded blocks, explicit mode per call, no global vmlSetMode.
Load standalone runtime lazily, validate ABI and version, bound native threads. No libtorch_cpu fallback and no runtime network/download.

Missing selected runtime is a clear capability error, never silent alternate arithmetic. A portable SLEEF alternative cannot count as passing originalCura policy without all unchanged full-output gates.
Independent standalone-MKL parity must be measured; symbols exported from libtorch_cpu are diagnosis only.
